steps: Heat the oil on medium, add the cumin and wait until it sizzles.
Add the onion and green chilli and fry for about 5 minutes, until the onion is light golden.
Stir in the ginger and garlic for about a minute, until the raw smell goes.
Add the tomato and cook on low to medium, stirring, until soft and pulpy and oil shows at the edges.
Stir in the turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and salt and cook for a minute.
Add the potato, carrot, beans, cauliflower, peas and capsicum and stir-fry on medium-high for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add about 60 ml hot water a person, cover and cook on low to medium for about 15 minutes, until the vegetables are fork tender.
Stir in the cream and garam masala, turn off the heat and top with the coriander leaves.
note: One recipe used about 90 g of vegetables a person and the other about 130 g; this follows the larger one, a fair share for a main vegetable dish.
